R1_vertical_alignment.referenceMeasure: tc_tilt_magnitude near 8 km divided by max(tc_rmw near 2 km, 10 km)
R1_vertical_alignment.simulationDiagnostic: distance between low-level and upper-level vortex centers normalized by simulated low-level RMW

R2_tangential_column_coherence.referenceMeasure: median Pearson correlation between 2-km radial tangential-wind profile and 4/6/8-km profiles within 0-150 km
R2_tangential_column_coherence.simulationDiagnostic: radial tangential-wind profile similarity across diagnostic levels

R3_vorticity_column_coherence.referenceMeasure: median cosine similarity between positive-vorticity radial profiles near 2 km and 4/6/8-km profiles within 0-100 km
R3_vorticity_column_coherence.simulationDiagnostic: positive-vorticity radial-profile similarity across diagnostic levels

R4_inflow_outflow_coupling.referenceMeasure: minimum of inner-core low-level convergence magnitude and upper-level divergence magnitude
R4_inflow_outflow_coupling.simulationDiagnostic: paired low-level convergence and upper-level divergence strength inside storm core

R5_convective_vertical_continuity.referenceMeasure: fraction of >=20 dBZ low-level convective pixels remaining >=20 dBZ near 6 and 8 km
R5_convective_vertical_continuity.simulationDiagnostic: fraction of supported deep-convective columns continuous from low to upper diagnostic levels
